# Copilot instructions for this repository

Purpose: concise, actionable guidance for Copilot sessions and future contributors working on this static site.

---

## Build / serve / test / lint commands
- This is a static single-page site (no package.json, no test suite, no linter configured).
- Local preview (recommended):
  - If a system `serve` binary is installed: run `which serve` to confirm. Then run:
    - `serve` (run from the repo root; the tool serves the site and typically listens on port 8080 by default; open http://localhost:8080/)
  - If Node is available but no global `serve`: `npx serve` (run from repo root)
- GitHub Pages: a `CNAME` exists; pushing to the default branch publishes the site via Pages.
- Tests: none present. To add tests, add a test framework (e.g., Jest, Playwright) and update this file with the single-test invocation.
- Linting: none configured. If ESLint/Stylelint is added later, include the single-file lint command here.

---

## High-level architecture
- Single-page static site: `index.html` is the entry point.
- Static assets:
  - Styles: `main.css`
  - Scripts: `main.js` (drives dynamic gallery & UI behavior)
  - Images: `img/` (gallery and hero backgrounds)
  - Vendor Bootstrap is checked in under `btstrap/` and used via `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`.
- Gallery flow:
  - `main.js` defines `galleryImages` (array of filenames). On DOMContentLoaded it calls `loadGallery()` which creates gallery cards and binds click handlers to open a Bootstrap modal showing the image.
  - Image paths are constructed using `encodeURI()`; filenames with spaces and parentheses are intentionally preserved.
- Styling:
  - `main.css` contains CSS variables in `:root` for the color system and many site-specific utility classes (glass-card, hero-section, gallery-card).
  - Hero background is set in CSS (not in HTML/JS), so updating the hero image requires editing `main.css`.

---

## Key repository conventions and gotchas
- Gallery updates: add the image file to `img/` and append its exact filename (including spaces/parentheses) to the `galleryImages` array in `main.js`. The code uses `encodeURI()` so filenames must match exactly.
- Vendor folder name: Bootstrap is stored in `btstrap/` (not `bootstrap/`). Tools or scripts referencing vendor assets should use `btstrap/` unless you standardize and rename the folder (update references in `index.html` and any CSS/JS).
- Image encoding: `main.js` uses `encodeURI(src)` when composing `img/` paths — avoid pre-encoding filenames; add them verbatim to `galleryImages`.
- Anchor IDs used by nav: `#hero`, `#features`, `#gallery`, `#about`. Keep these ids if changing sections to preserve smooth-scroll behavior and nav links.
- Script order matters: `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` must load before `main.js` (bootstrap Collapse/Modal used by `main.js`). Keep their order as-is in `index.html`.
- Content language tag: `index.html` uses `lang="en"` but page content is Spanish; consider aligning `lang` with page language if accessibility/SEO matters.
- Deployment: presence of `CNAME` indicates GitHub Pages deployment—verify branch/settings if publishing changes.
